instruction: Enter 'High Rate Count' in F1, then use COUNTIF in F2 to count investments in D2:D5 with annual interest rates above 0.10.

metadata.explanation: This task requires counting investments with interest rate > 0.10 in column D (D2:D5). The interest rates are: 0.18, 0.06, 0.11, 0.05. Verified with Python: count = 2 (rates 0.18 and 0.11 are above 0.10). The task has two parts: (1) add header 'High Rate Count' in F1, (2) calculate count in F2. The evaluator checks both cells F1 and F2: F1 must contain the exact text 'High Rate Count' and F2 must contain the integer value 2. Custom getter extracts both cell values and custom metric validates both the header text and the count value.
